title: Naturally Nutty Ethiopian Beef Tagine
description: A salty, silky, festive Ethiopian dish featuring sesame butter and a braise. Perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.
instructions: Heat the sesame butter in a ceramic tagine over medium heat until melted and fragrant.
Add the onions and cook until lightly browned, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger; cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, cayenne pepper, turmeric, salt, and black pepper; cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the berbere spice and tomato paste; cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Transfer the tagine to the oven and braise for 1 hour and 30 minutes, or until the meat is tender.
Serve the tagine over rice or with injera bread.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
